independent_review.boundary_failure_scope: Six F32/F16 decoder native-vision, native-positions, native-frontend arms fail at prefill.decoder.norm and full_prefix.decoder.norm; prepared decoders and owning OCR still return original IDs/text.
independent_review.timing_scope: Per-command wall/RSS retained; original HF and native owning use different thread counts and are not a paired speed comparison.
limits: Run source ac1bb9cb is an intentional bounds/frontend change and precedes separate final-core replay; this receipt does not qualify that later source.
Default remains 1024 patches; 2048 is opt-in and fails numerical parity in this run. No 2880-squared, multi-image, video, GPU or release claim.
Strict vision exceedances remain visible for all cases; boundary decoder norm calibrated ratios exceed one and six arms reject. Exact decoded output does not waive numerical failure.

Six failed-arm GNU time files start with a nonzero-exit line followed by valid resource JSON; RSS and wall time in this receipt were recovered from those files because producer.commands omits resources on failed commands.
The 512, 640x480 and 2048 authored inputs are one text sample each; double newline gives raw CER 1/15 and WER 0, while whitespace-normalized CER/WER are zero.
Original PNG, NPZ, GGUF and native vector payloads reside in large remote artifacts; this review independently checked service metadata and small report/log/manifest bytes only.
